scripts.build: npm run prebuild && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && tar czf /tmp/civic-mock-dist.tar.gz -C dist . && scp /tmp/civic-mock-dist.tar.gz sano-vps:/tmp/ && ssh sano-vps "rm -rf /var/www/civic-mock/* && tar xzf /tmp/civic-mock-dist.tar.gz -C /var/www/civic-mock && chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/civic-mock && rm /tmp/civic-mock-dist.tar.gz"
